sources.title: Action as the Fifth Modality in Multimodal AI
sources.snippet: By treating action outputs (API calls, robot motions, etc.) as model-native outputs, AI systems can interface with the world directly rather than just describing it. Industry Perspectives and Future Outlook Both academia and industry are increasingly supportive of expanding multimodal AI to include action.
